name: Dragon Spring Farm
description: A small pumpkin patch in 115 Santa Rosa Creek Road, CA, Dragon Spring Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
